display.purpose: Hero greeting only; two words, second word in the time-aware accent.

section-label.purpose: Section openers, paired with a right-aligned trailing count.

micro-label.purpose: Room/device names, datelines, captions. The workhorse.

mono-value.purpose: Every numeral: percentages, temps, amps, counts.

shadows.name: slider-thumb-glow
shadows.purpose: Web slider thumb hover/focus. The single sanctioned shadow in the system.

motion.name: ease-interaction
motion.purpose: Direct-manipulation feedback (fills, markers); suppressed while dragging.

motion.name: settle-delay
motion.purpose: Idle time before deferred removals compact the lights section.

components.name: Dimmable Pill
components.description: Signature light control: sharp rectangle whose Ink Orange fill IS the brightness, capped by a 2px marker needle.
components.css: .ds-pill { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; height: 40px; padding: 0 10px; background: #F2F2F7; border: 0.5px solid rgba(198,198,200,0.3); cursor: pointer; overflow: hidden; } .ds-pill-fill { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; background: rgba(237,91,33,0.15); transition: width 0.15s ease-out; pointer-events: none; } .ds-pill-marker { position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; left: calc(100% - 2px); width: 2px; background: #ED5B21; transition: left 0.15s ease-out; pointer-events: none; } .ds-pill-name { position: relative; font-family: -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.6px; color: #000; } .ds-pill-value { position: relative; font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: #ED5B21; } .ds-pill:hover .ds-pill-fill { background: rgba(237,91,33,0.22); }

components.name: Dimmable Pill (off, lingering)
components.description: A turned-off pill drains in place and dims to tertiary ink; tap to undo. Compacts after the 2.5s settle.
components.css: .ds-pill-off { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; height: 40px; padding: 0 10px; background: #F2F2F7; border: 0.5px solid rgba(198,198,200,0.3); cursor: pointer; } .ds-pill-off-name { font-family: -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.6px; color: rgba(60,60,67,0.3); } .ds-pill-off-value { font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(60,60,67,0.6); }

components.name: Section Header
components.description: Section opener: tracked caps, optional Ink Orange text action, right-aligned live count.
components.html: LIGHTS ON8 ACTIVE
components.css: .ds-secthead { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 12px; background: #FFFFFF; padding: 4px 0; } .ds-secthead-title { font-family: -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 1.2px; color: #000; } .ds-secthead-spacer { flex: 1; } .ds-secthead-action { font-family: -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.8px; color: #ED5B21; background: none; border: none; padding: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-secthead-action:hover { color: #C24518; } .ds-secthead-action:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #ED5B21; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-secthead-count { font-family: -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.8px; color: rgba(60,60,67,0.6); }

components.name: Masthead
components.description: Time-aware hero greeting: two words, second in the period accent. Bebas Neue appears here and nowhere else.
components.css: .ds-masthead { background: #FFFFFF; padding: 8px 0; } .ds-masthead-dateline { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-family: -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 1px; color: rgba(60,60,67,0.6); margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-masthead-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #4CAF50; } .ds-masthead-hero { font-family: 'Bebas Neue', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 48px; line-height: 1; color: #000; } .ds-masthead-accent { color: #F2A626; }

components.name: Status Cell
components.description: One cell of the 3-column status grid: icon + caption + mono value, active state carried by color alone.
components.html:
3 ON
PLAYROOM
components.css: .ds-statcell { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; width: 110px; padding: 10px; background: #F2F2F7; border: 0.5px solid rgba(198,198,200,0.3); } .ds-statcell-top { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; color: #ED5B21; } .ds-statcell-value { font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; color: #ED5B21; } .ds-statcell-label { font-family: -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.4px; color: #000; }

components.name: Panel Light Pill (web)
components.description: The Night Desk expression of the dimmable pill: amber fill on dark surface, radius 8.
components.css: .ds-panelpill { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 36px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid rgba(245,166,35,0.25); background: #1E1E1E; cursor: pointer; } .ds-panelpill-fill { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 75%; background: rgba(245,166,35,0.32); transition: width 0.15s ease-out; pointer-events: none; } .ds-panelpill-name { position: relative; flex: 1; font-family: -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; color: #F5A623; } .ds-panelpill-value { position: relative; font-family: -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: rgba(245,166,35,0.7); } .ds-panelpill:hover { border-color: #F5A623; }

components.name: Panel Button (web)
components.description: MUI outlined action on the Night Desk: the one place buttons get chrome.
components.css: .ds-panelbtn { font-family: -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #E0E0E0; background: #1E1E1E; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-panelbtn:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border-color: #F5A623; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-panelbtn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F5A623; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: The home is rendered as a beautifully typeset newspaper front page. The masthead greets by time of day, the dateline reads like a paper's coordinates, sections open with small tracked capitals and a right-aligned count, and every figure is set in bold monospace like a stock table. Data is the news; typography is the entire decoration budget. Components are typeset, not drawn: hairline rules, sharp rectangles, and fills that behave like ink coverage stand in for borders, shadows, and chrome. The system has two deliberate platform expressions: iOS is the Morning Edition (black ink on white paper, Ink Orange as the second color on the press); web is the Night Desk (the same dense instrument read against #121212 with amber as its working light). Same capabilities, same density, different paper stock.
keyCharacteristics: Information density over whitespace: show the whole house at a glance
Typography-first: hierarchy from tracked caps, condensed display, and mono figures, not boxes
Flat as the page: zero shadows on iOS; depth is ink, not light
Color is semantic, never mood (the one exception: the time-aware hero accent)
Direct manipulation: the control IS the readout (drag the pill, the fill is the value)

rules.name: The Two-Ink Rule
rules.body: The iOS page prints in black and Ink Orange. Any third color on screen must be carrying a semantic payload (cooling, safe, alarm, appliance state) or the time-aware masthead. A color with no meaning is forbidden.

rules.name: The Live-Ink Rule
rules.body: Ink Orange marks what is active or actionable right now. Never use it on idle, historical, or purely informational elements; those are black, secondary, or gray.

rules.name: The Masthead Rule
rules.body: Bebas Neue appears exactly once per screen, in the hero. Everywhere else is tracked capitals at 9-11pt. A second display-size element would make two front pages.

rules.name: The Stock-Table Rule
rules.body: Every numeral renders in bold mono (or tabular-nums on web). If a number is proportionally spaced, it's a bug.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: If a surface needs to feel separate on iOS, give it a hairline or a paper-gray fill. box-shadow/.shadow() is prohibited. On web, any shadow other than the slider-thumb glow is prohibited.

dos: Do set every number in bold mono / tabular-nums, uppercase every label, and keep tracking between 0.4 and 1.2.
Do make the control the readout: fills and markers that ARE the value (pill fill = brightness, bar = climate state).
Do hold layout still during rapid interaction: defer removals (~2.5s settle), keep sticky column assignments, animate compaction once at .easeInOut 0.25s.
Do add the data point when in doubt; density is the brand ("show more, not less" per PRODUCT.md).
Do express state through color with fixed meanings: Ink Orange/amber = active/actionable, blue = cooling, green = safe, red = alarm, gray = idle.
donts: Don't use skeuomorphism, playful/rounded UI (Notion, Linear), or light-and-airy sparse dashboards; those are PRODUCT.md's named anti-references.
Don't draw shadows on iOS or any web shadow beyond the slider-thumb glow. No .ultraThinMaterial, no glassmorphism, no gradients: the old dark glass theme is retired.
Don't use entrance animations, staggers, springs, or bounce. Motion communicates state change, not personality.
Don't round the Dimmable Pill or status cells on iOS; sharp corners are the print signature. Cards cap at 8pt.
Don't put Ink Orange on idle or informational elements, and never introduce a meaningless accent color (The Two-Ink Rule).
Don't set Bebas Neue anywhere but the hero (The Masthead Rule).
Don't wrap sections in cards by default; the page IS the container. If it looks like a grid of identical SaaS cards, it has failed.
Don't waste space on empty states; collapse empty sections entirely (the lights section removes itself when nothing is on).
